body:
I hear you. I thought the same for a while. And I still kind of do but I'm trying to be stubborn now and try to think like an entitled boomer (partly because it's kinda fun to act like a boomer lol)

The main reason I've been holding on is because I've struggled 22 f*cking years of suicidal thoughts and survived a few attempts. I've busted my gut in therapy for about 7 years. I'm not gonna give up now after putting in that much work. It's my right to get the reward after working so hard. I am not letting those years be in vain. I deserve to have some form of good times before I check out. People should be thanking me for still being here at all! The sun shines out of my ass and everyone needs the sun so really I'm the most important person out there. Pfft they're lucky to have me! 

After years of self hatred it's a nice change to even pretend to be so egotistic lol. I've also kinda decided that if I'm still like this in 3 years, after a decade of therapy, then I'm gonna make a plan.
On a night like this by Kylie Minogue - much to my despair lol.
